name: Fish Plate
description: The fishes of the waters around the panel as a natural-history plate: the most recorded species on iNaturalist within a radius, in lateral view, stacked on cream paper with their names in script beneath, a plate title and number and a scale bar. Photographs, or AI paintings in five styles after Bloch, gyotaku and others.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Place
cell_options.help: Whose waters to draw. Falls back to the app-level location in Settings when empty.

cell_options.name: source
cell_options.label: Source
cell_options.help: The place looks at every research-grade fish record within the radius. An iNaturalist username draws the fishes that one person has recorded, anywhere.

cell_options.name: inat_user
cell_options.label: iNaturalist username
cell_options.help: The login name as it appears in the address of their profile page.

cell_options.name: radius_km
cell_options.label: Within
cell_options.help: How far round the place to look.

cell_options.name: count
cell_options.label: How many
cell_options.help: Species on the plate, the most recorded first. Small cells show fewer: one at sm, what fits at md.

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout
cell_options.help: Stacked plate is the fishes one above another with a name line under each. Hero is the most recorded fish large inside a ruled frame, with the next two small in the lower corners.

cell_options.name: pictures
cell_options.label: Pictures
cell_options.help: Photographs cost nothing: each species' openly licensed photo from iNaturalist in a soft oval, with its credit. AI paintings paint each species once, from that photo, in the style below, at about US$0.04 a species; the plate shows the photograph until the painting lands. Needs a fal.ai key in this widget's settings or under Settings, Generative AI.

cell_options.name: style
cell_options.label: Style
cell_options.help: The style every painting is made in. Each style is painted once per species and kept. Gyotaku and the line drawing are black ink only, the ones for a black and white panel.

cell_options.name: window
cell_options.label: Window
cell_options.help: Which records count. All time ranks the species by every research-grade record there has ever been; the shorter windows follow what people are finding now.

cell_options.name: waters
cell_options.label: Waters
cell_options.help: The name of the water for the plate title, such as the Yarra or Port Phillip Bay: the title becomes FISHES OF <waters>. Blank gives FISHES NEAR <place>.

cell_options.name: panel
cell_options.label: Panel
cell_options.help: What the panel can show. Pictures are converted and contrast-stretched to match; on black and white the type is thickened.

cell_options.name: model
cell_options.label: Model
cell_options.help: All on fal.ai, all painting from a photo of the species. Nano Banana is faithful and cheap; Nano Banana Pro follows an unusual instruction better and draws finer detail; FLUX.1 Kontext Pro adheres most strongly to a style; GPT Image 2 is a good likeness with a narrower range; Seedream 4 is the budget one. A painting made with one model is kept when you switch to another.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank uses the waters or the place.

cell_options.name: credits
cell_options.label: Credits
cell_options.help: The photographers and licences at the foot of the plate. The CC licences ask for them, so leave this on where the panel is seen by others.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key (AI paintings)
settings.help: With a key the widget can paint each fish from its own photograph, at about US$0.04 a painting, once per species and style. Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys; it is only sent to fal.run. Without one the widget shows photographs.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widget may spend on new paintings in a day, at the models' listed prices (US$2 is about fifty Nano Banana paintings). 0 is no limit. Paintings are kept, so a species in a style only costs once.

settings.name: gen_per_refresh
settings.label: New paintings started per preview
settings.help: How many new paintings one settled preview in the editor may start (1 to 50). A panel's own render starts what its page needs, within the daily number.
